title: Conformal geometry of spherical FK maps at weight four
exact_target: For FK weight $q=4$, do canonical conformal embeddings of finite spherical n-edge maps converge jointly in area measure, the full rescaled distance graph and the complete nested loop collection to the critical $\gamma =2$ quantum sphere with its critical metric and loop decoration, for a deterministic $a_n\to 0$ and every $n\to \infty $? Include vanishing spherical flag-triangle mesh.
